en.bdb: Craftsmanship is there in the creation

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਨਕੁ ਕੰਨ ਸਵਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: jeeau pai tan saajiaa muh akhee nak ka(n)n savaare|

en.bdb: Creating the jiva (self) He made his body and gave good shape to his mouth, nose, eyes and ears.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਥ ਪੈਰ ਦੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਭ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: hath pair dhe dhaat kar sabadh surat subh dhisaT dhuaare|

en.bdb: Gracefully He bestowed hands and feet, ears and consciousness for listening to the Word and eye for beholding goodness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸੰਜਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: kirat virat parakirat bahu saas giraas nivaas sa(n)jaare|

en.bdb: For earning of the livelihood and other works, he infused life into body.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਪਰਸਦੇ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: raag ra(n)g ras parasadhe ga(n)dh suga(n)dh sa(n)dh parakaare|

en.bdb: He bestowed various techniques of assimilation of music, colours, smells and fragrances.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲੁ ਟੇਕ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: chhaadhan bhojan budh bal Tek bibek veechaar veechaare|

en.bdb: For clothing and eating He gave wisdom, power, devotion, and discriminatory wisdom and thought process.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: dhaane keemat naa pavai besumaar dhaataar piaare|

en.bdb: The mysteries of that Bestower cannot be understood; that loving Donor keeps with Him myriad's of virtues.
Beyond all accounts, He is infinite and unfathomable.
